text:
maria: Heads-up: large reconnect wave in eu-west this morning, looks correlated with token rotations. streams drop then clients hammer reconnects.
kevin: how big is the spike? any specific flow (resume vs fresh auth)?
maria: mostly resume-token flows. quick pattern: client connects -> proxy gets 401 while keyring rotates -> client retries quickly -> spike. sample trace below.
raj: can you paste the log snippet?
maria: sure:
```
[10:12:12] GET /v1/stream resume_id=xyz tenant=acme -> 401
[10:12:12] proxy fetching auth token (rotation in-progress)
[10:12:13] auth-svc validate resume_id=xyz -> 200
[10:12:13] proxy accepts connection -> SSE stream opened
[client] 10:12:13 EOF -> reconnect
```
kevin: looks like ~1s blocking inside proxy when keyring refresh happens. that amplifies for high-fanout tenants.
sara: i dug into traces. proxy holds a keyring mutex during refresh, and auth calls queue up. keyring_refresh_block_ms jumps to ~900ms during rotation windows.
raj: can we avoid blocking the request path? maybe async refresh with a short-lived fallback token.
maria: short-term mitigations: (A) update SDK to add randomized jitter for reconnect backoff (e.g., 300-900ms), (B) have proxy return Retry-After on auth-failure during rotation to signal clients to back off, (C) add a console alert rule for auth_handoff_latency and link it to redeploys.
kevin: (B) seems low-risk. if proxy returns 503 + Retry-After when rotation-flag set, clients won't hammer. but note this will change how we account reconnections in billing/metrics.
raj: yes billing could show duplicate sessions. we should also implement a short dedupe window on resume tokens so retries within X seconds don't create duplicate billable sessions.
sara: long-term: move keyring refresh off the hot path, keep a hot cache, and emit keyring_refresh_block_ms metric. i'll add an exporter for that.
maria: our streaming dashboard is currently coarse: sse_reconnect_rate by region only. can we add a tenant-scoped heatmap and auth_handoff_latency timeline? current query is: sum(rate(sse_reconnect_total[5m])) by (region). propose adding avg(auth_handoff_latency_ms) by (tenant, region).
kevin: UX idea: when a deploy touches auth/keyring, annotate the streaming dashboard automatically for the canary window and surface correlated anomalies.
sara: we already capture deploy events. implement a post-deploy scan: for 10m after deploy check auth_handoff_latency_ms p95 against baseline; surface an alert card if > threshold.
raj: i'll prototype the metric export and a small dedupe mechanism (3s window keyed by resume_id + client_ip). minimal memory impact.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-251 created and assigned to kevin.
kevin: plan of action: 1) canary proxy hotfix (return 503+Retry-After during rotation, behind feature flag) 2) SDK reconnect jitter recommendation + release note 3) add keyring_refresh_block_ms metric + dashboard heatmap 4) implement resume dedupe window
maria: please also add a console tile showing recent deploys + streaming spikes so on-call can triage faster.
kevin: watchlist for canary: sse_reconnect_rate, auth_handoff_latency_ms, keyring_refresh_block_ms, sse_reconnect_billing_delta. finance on standby if billing delta spikes.
sara: opening PR for proxy change (feature-flagged) and adding metric hooks. assigning exporter PR to @raj.
raj: starting on exporter + dedupe patch. ETA end of next sprint for full fix; hotfix rolling in 5% eu-west canary at 10:30 UTC.
ops-bot: deployment scheduled: proxy-rotation-backoff-canary -> 10:30 UTC (canary: 5% eu-west).
maria: thanks. i'll post graphs after canary. :thumbsup:
kevin: one more note: ensure Retry-After value is conservative (10s) to avoid prolonged user impact but reduce thundering herd.
raj: noted, will default to 10s for rotation windows and make it configurable.
sara: also adding a transient server-side state to suppress duplicate billing events for quick retries.
maria: ok team, keep this thread updated with canary metrics.
kevin: will report after 10:30 canary.
